name: szentiras.eu Reference Formatter
description: Field formatter that turns Bible reference strings into scripture text fetched from the szentiras.eu API, with a lightweight proxy endpoint for lazy loading.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 This module provide a custom field formatter for Bible references (simple plain text field) to szentiras.eu (formerly szentiras.hu). The module is mainly for Hungarian Drupal users, since szentiras.hu provides Hungarian Bible translations only. Currently supports 3 behaviours:

 
 Simple link: create a link to szentiras.eu. 
 Load text on click: on clicking loads the referenced text from szentiras.eu by its API . 
 Auto load text: load all referenced text on page onload event from szentiras.hu by its API. 
 
 Similar projects 
 Szentirashu is a Drupal 7 reftagger modul for szentiras.hu.
